title: 1.7 Inverse Trigonometric Functions

icans: I can evaluate inverse trigonometric functions exactly and with a calculator.
I can use the inverse properties of trigonometric functions.
I can evaluate compositions of trigonometric and inverse trigonometric functions.

vocab: y = __________ x means sin y = x, with −π/2 ≤ y ≤ π/2
y = __________ x means cos y = x, with 0 ≤ y ≤ π
y = __________ x means tan y = x, with −π/2 < y < π/2

blocks.p: Graph y = sin x and y = 1/2.

head: Question
Answer
rows: How many x-values give sin x = 1/2?
An interval where cos x passes the Horizontal Line Test

blocks.sec: Part 2 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: arcsin x gives the angle in [−π/2, π/2] whose sine is x. arccos x gives the angle in _______________.

blocks.stem:
Evaluate.
a.  arcsin(−1/2)
b.  arccos(−1)
c.  arctan 1
d.  arcsin 2

Use a calculator in radian mode.
a.  arctan(−8.45)
b.  arcsin 0.2447

notes: Inverse properties: sin(arcsin x) = x for −1 ≤ x ≤ 1; arcsin(sin y) = y only for y in _______________.

blocks.stem:
Evaluate, if possible.
a.  tan(arctan(−5))
b.  arcsin(sin 5π/3)
c.  cos(cos⁻¹ π)

notes: Compositions: draw a right triangle for the inside angle, then use _______________.

blocks.stem:
Find the exact value.
a.  tan(arccos 2/3)
b.  cos(arcsin(−3/5))
